text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend has been feeling off lately. We 
visited a shrine for a change of pace, 
when...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, did you wash your hands at the 
water pavilion~? Rinsed your mouth too~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mhm, looks all good.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, just to be sure, let's confirm. 
Checking Tran-chan's shrine visit routine.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Straighten your back, and bow slowly 
twice.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aligning the fingers of both hands, she 
claps twice. —And then, bows one more 
time.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Got it down, Trainy? Do it with me, just 
like I showed ya, alright?
choice_data_list: You're being pretty thorough today, huh.

You're being quite thorough today, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Tran-chan's in the mood for a 
nice, long chat with the gods today~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainy, go ahead and pray. I'll 
go sweep up the shrine grounds.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I gotta let God know how I feel, right? 
Like, 'Thanks for always watching over 
me!'"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"The priest gave me the okay, too. 
...Right now, I just want to struggle as 
much as I can."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems intent on praying earnestly 
without relying on gadgets or efficiency. 
If she's confronting her poor health to 
that extent, then—!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, feeling inspired now? Nice, nice! 
Welcooome!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Then Trainer-chan, use that bamboo broom 
over there. I'll...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna conquer everything with this 
pressure washer~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Besides, having the gods experience how 
great gadgets are will probably hype 
things up even more, you know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The lottery results for the 
limited-edition gadget being announced 
today!
choice_data_list: So it is gadgets after all...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What's with the 'I knew it'!? The shrine 
gets cleaned up too, so it's a win-win, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's polish it till it shines to 
the absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, just as the two of us finished 
cleaning the shrine...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mmh? This ringtone is...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Notification of New Smartphone Lottery 
Results" —Ooh, here it is, here it is...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"—'Winner: Preparing for Shipment'~~! The 
heavens heard me! My love for gadgets 
reached them~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether from the momentum of winning or a 
blessing from above, Transcend's condition 
even made a full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...*slumps*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, having lost the lottery 
draw, her condition remained stubbornly 
out of sync...
